description: This Java class 'ValidateMethod' performs validation by invoking a specified static method on a given class, used within the minilang operation framework of the OFBiz project.

classes.name: ValidateMethod
classes.description: A class that executes validation by calling a specified static method on a class, based on XML element attributes.

methods.name: ValidateMethod
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the validation class and method names from XML attributes.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the validation by converting input, loading the class, invoking the method, and handling validation result.
